items.title: Functorial K-injective replacements with injective terms
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs functorially, for every complex in a Grothendieck abelian category, a complex receiving a termwise injective quasi-isomorphism whose terms all factor through injective subobjects (statement lines 1959-1972). The proof is a complete construction: functorial injective embeddings of the objects are chosen and the auxiliary complexes are recalled (proof lines 1974-1980), the replacement complex is assembled out of products of those auxiliary complexes with the comparison map defined by the functorial embeddings (proof lines 1980-2014), and the two asserted properties are read off: injectivity and the factorisation come from the construction and the quasi-isomorphism from the long exact cohomology sequence of the associated short exact sequences of complexes (proof lines 2015-2020). The non-formal content is the assembly of the functorial replacement. The claim is H2.
